name: cohort-fused
description: One logit per cohort and one never-treated OLS for all periods; every cell's doubly robust influence function evaluated per unit in a fused Numba pass that also forms the simple, event-time and pre/post aggregates (no n_units x n_cells matrix); exact reference code for non-converging cohorts and numerically-zero cells. Threads: NUMBA_NUM_THREADS.
